title: Chicken & Beef Broccoli (tonight)
summary: Tonight’s stir-fry: velvet chicken + beef, blanched broccoli, mild oyster-soy glaze. Full recipe saved in the library — cook-tonight status.
ingredientsOnHand: Beef (flank/sirloin/flat iron, thin against the grain)
Soy/tamari, oyster sauce, cornstarch, baking soda
steps: Velvet chicken and beef 15 min; whisk sauce.
Sear beef, then chicken, high heat; hold on a plate.
Garlic + ginger, broccoli, both meats, sauce until glossy; sesame oil off heat.
justinAdaptations: Mild — no chili oil or flakes
Stevia / 0-sugar syrup instead of sugar in sauce
Cauliflower rice optional for lower carb
